title: Smart Budgets Sprint Planning
summary: The team set the public launch date for Smart Budgets to October 15th and chose Plaid as the bank‑sync provider for this sprint. Aisha will integrate Plaid in the sandbox with staging syncs ready by Friday, while Jordan will prototype an LLM‑based transaction categorizer and report accuracy by the sprint review on the 19th. A design review of the onboarding mocks is scheduled for the 22nd, with Elena sending the Figma link by Thursday. The question of supporting shared budgets for couples remains open for a later decision.
key_points: Sprint goal is to deliver the budgeting engine and bank sync end‑to‑end
Public launch target fixed for October 15th
Decision to use Plaid for bank sync; cost ~30¢ per connected account per month
Plaid sandbox integration to be in staging by Friday
Current rule‑based categorizer accuracy is 70%; need 90% for launch
Plan to prototype an LLM categorizer and measure accuracy by sprint review
Design onboarding mocks ready; design review set for the 22nd
Figma link to be shared by Thursday
Shared budgets for couples left as an open question

decisions.decision: Public launch date set to October 15th
Use Plaid for bank sync at launch
Shared budgets will not be included at launch and will be decided later

action_items.task: Write decision doc and share with finance
